prompt: Read input.json at execution time. Write result.json with exactly overdue, dueToday, upcoming, closed keys, each an array of record IDs sorted ascending ASCII. closed:true always goes in closed regardless of date. For other records compare dueDate to asOf as ISO calendar dates: earlier is overdue, equal is dueToday, later is upcoming. Do not use the current system date, time zones, or business-day adjustments. Include each record exactly once. Do not change input.json.
